semiconductor_relevance: High — Fujikin manufactures specialized gas mass flow valves and control systems critical for high purity processes in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Fujikin of America produces gas mass flow valves, fittings, and control systems designed for high purity process equipment in the semiconductor industry. Their products enhance productivity in semiconductor manufacturing by ensuring efficient gas delivery and uniform film thickness during deposition processes.
capabilities: High purity fittings and control systems
Flow control systems with pressure and thermal methods

regional_presence.United States: Fujikin of America operates in the U.S. market, focusing on high purity process equipment.
